title: Oshkosh, WI — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Oshkosh, WI: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Oshkosh is a city in WI with a population of 67,000. Home of the EAA AirVenture Oshkosh and the University of Wisconsin-Oshkosh. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.2.
